reason: The text explicitly describes Yahweh's provision of a deliverer for Israel. An angel announces that Samson will 'begin to save Israel from the hand of the Philistines' (יָחֵ֛ל לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים), and Yahweh empowers Samson through the Spirit to accomplish victories against the Philistines. The narrative shows Yahweh actively intervening to provide relief and leadership (judging Israel for 20 years). However, this wellbeing is presented within a covenantal framework where Yahweh punishes Israel for evil (delivering them to Philistine oppression for 40 years) before providing deliverance. Thus, Yahweh's desire for Israel's wellbeing is demonstrated but is conditional upon their covenant relationship and righteousness.
